description: Finds stale issues in the current sprint, prompts for manager approval, and transitions them back to the backlog with a notification comment.

activation.when: Use when the user wants to clean up stale issues in the current sprint and move them back to the backlog.

cutoff_days.description: Number of inactive days required to flag an issue as stale

project_key.description: The key of the Jira project to target

sprint_name.description: The name of the sprint to clean up

steps.description: Find issues in the specified project and sprint that have not been updated within the cutoff window.
steps.instruction: Search for all issues in project '{{inputs.project_key}}' and sprint '{{inputs.sprint_name}}' that are not 'Done' and have not been updated for more than {{inputs.cutoff_days}} days. Use the jira_search_issues tool. Put the matching issues in the step output under issues.

issues.description: Stale issues found in the sprint

steps.description: Pause for human review before moving stale issues to the backlog.
steps.question: Approve moving these stale issues (no updates in {{inputs.cutoff_days}} days) back to the backlog?

options.label: approved
options.description: Proceed with transitions for the selected issues

steps.description: Transition approved issues back to the 'To Do' column and post a descriptive comment on each.
steps.instruction: For each issue selected in {{steps.request-approver-review.output.selected}}, run the jira_transition_issue tool to move it to 'To Do' status, and run the jira_add_comment tool to add a comment indicating that this issue has been moved due to inactivity of {{inputs.cutoff_days}} days.

steps.description: Generate a final markdown summary of transitioned tickets and save it in the workspace.
steps.instruction: Write a summary report of the cleanup execution (which issues were transitioned and when) and save it as 'sprint_cleanup_report.md' in the workspace. Once done, declare completion to end the execution loop.
